description: A crowded mudbrick city seen from a raised rooftop. A large white temple with pilasters stands on a stepped terraced platform with stairways at the upper right. Flat-roofed houses fill the foreground and midground, with a long crenellated wall at the left edge. In the lower centre, a narrow street is packed with people carrying large baskets on their heads, and a few figures stand on rooftops. The sky is heavy and overcast, and the painting is warm brown and ochre. No visible text, frame or border.
